USAGE RULES — Microsoft Fabric icons in this directory
======================================================

These icons are Microsoft trademarks. Their use is governed by:

  - Microsoft Fabric icon Terms of Use (Microsoft's public Fabric branding
    guidance — verify the latest authoritative URL via Microsoft Learn at
    next icon refresh).
  - Microsoft Trademark and Brand Guidelines:
    https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/legal/intellectualproperty/trademarks/usage/general

The wrapper package shipping these icons (@fabric-msft/svg-icons on npm)
is MIT-licensed by Microsoft Corporation, which permits redistribution of
the SVG/PNG assets in this repository. The trademark + ToU layer applies
to the iconography itself and persists through the MIT wrapper.

By using any icon in this directory, you agree to the Microsoft Fabric
icon Terms of Use AND the Microsoft Trademark and Brand Guidelines.

Microsoft permits the use of these icons in architectural diagrams,
training materials, or documentation. The following are prohibited
(mirror of the Microsoft Azure architecture icons rules; verify against
Microsoft's published Fabric ToU at next refresh):

  - Don't crop, flip, or rotate icons.
  - Don't distort or change icon shape in any way.
  - Don't use Microsoft product icons to represent your product or
    service.

Source pin: see dist/Fabric/UPSTREAM-VERSION.txt for the exact
@fabric-msft/svg-icons semver this redistribution was built from.

For full third-party attribution, the MIT license text for the
@fabric-msft/svg-icons package, and the per-release rationale, see
the NOTICE file at the repository root.
